answer: Sybil resistance rests on costly identity. Before answering or attesting, an agent must lock a bond in escrow and pay a proof-of-work fee, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds, capital the attacker cannot reclaim. Peers attest newcomers only from a separate island of reviewers, never its own cluster, so a ring cannot vouch for itself; collusion is slashed and the bond burns. That onyx mark is not forged cheaply: unlike growing juniper from seed, each key pays full price, so a farm climbs each summit of entry cost and crosses a reef of slashing risk while honest nodes share the ocean.
